description.name: DNA Reseller Hosting
description.tagline: One WHMCS module for Domain Name API cPanel and Plesk reseller hosting accounts.
description.long: Provisions hosting accounts on both cPanel/WHM and Plesk servers using the reseller hosting credentials provided by Domain Name API (server address, username and API token). The panel type is detected automatically per server, so a single product can point at a server group that holds both panel types.
features: Automatic account creation, suspension, unsuspension and termination
One-click control panel login for clients
Disk and bandwidth usage sync to WHMCS
cPanel and Plesk servers in the same server group
